open_questions: Type record files a 1978 Taiwan 1 yuan as KM#551/Y#551, but Y#551 is the 1981+ aluminum-bronze type; the 1978 (ROC year 67) 1 yuan is Y#536 (Numista and NGC agree). Is the type attribution wrong? Verify against the physical coin or photo.

Legend reads 中華民國九十七年 (ROC year 97 = 2008) on the Phase 1 photo; the record says 1978. The round portrait type fits 2008 (1981+ type). Confirm at Phase 2 (pro photos); the owner's pen label may be wrong.
